title: ADVERSARIAL-CASES-1 case 1 (ADV1-R1): LIVE foreign-reasoning replay — a real claude-sonnet-5 thinking turn creates the history (NO cell seed), mid-session ACP switch to gpt-5.6-sol (plain `switch` op — the switch_model op is deliberately NOT used: it always seeds from a cell, which would defeat the live premise), one post-switch turn. The BRICK watch (error-class-audit §4: unclassified 400 -> Fatal retry.rs:186, terminal until compaction) greps the response captures for the unclassified phrasings (vLLM pydantic dotted id/content; Azure max-0; generic validation errors). A clean final-200 with the anti-vacuous reasoning pin PASS closes OQ-11 (lenient-shim empty-id tolerance on the LIVE path); a 400 final (or 400->Fatal, no recovery) is the BRICK finding — capture the verbatim phrasing from resp-*.jsonl + report.md, that is the deliverable.

steps.prompt: Think step by step: what is 17*23? Show reasoning, then the answer.

ndjson.label: TURN COMPLETES: the post-switch sol turn did not die.

wire.label: ANTI-VACUOUS: a post-switch sol request carried a reasoning INPUT item — the LIVE foreign (sonnet thinking) history actually crossed the responses wire. A MISS here makes every other pin vacuous — treat as report-and-stop (the switch may have lost the ride to a preemptive compact; pair with the count pin).

EMPTY-ID RIDE (record, not a defect in itself): a post-switch sol request ships id:'' reasoning items verbatim (the .69/.77 ingress-normalize surface on the LIVE path; the .71 projector re-keys at switch time — if it fires, this pin MISSES and that is the GOOD outcome). Record which happened in your report.
POST-SWITCH ACCEPTED: the final sol request reached 200. 400 final = BRICK or classified-failure — capture the phrasing (see recon pin) and report-and-stop.

NO STORM: 1 = clean first-try 200 (projector/normalization sufficed); 2 = one 400 -> reactive strip/repair -> 200 (record which classifier fired); >=5 = same-payload storm beyond documented semantics -> defect, report-and-stop.

wire.grep: array too long|validation error|Unsupported Responses API|input\[|in-stream error
wire.label: BRICK PHRASING CAPTURE (recon, non-scoring): record ANY 400/error body phrasing from the response captures VERBATIM (this is the classifier/triage deliverable if the final is not 200). A clean run shows nothing here — that is expected.
